headline: Microsoft (MSFT) Might Face EU Probe Over 2020 Slack Complaint
text: Microsoft (MSFT) Might Face EU Probe Over 2020 Slack Complaint. The European Union is considering an antitrust investigation into Microsoft's bundling of its Teams collaboration app with the Office suite, following a complaint from Salesforce-owned Slack. The EU is concerned that Microsoft is using its dominant position to push its cloud services, making it difficult for customers to switch to other providers.

headline: Shell (SHEL) Settles $1.1 Billion Corruption Case in Nigeria
text: Shell (SHEL) Settles $1.1 Billion Corruption Case in Nigeria. Shell and Eni have reached a settlement with Nigeria, withdrawing a $1.1 billion civil claim related to a 2011 oilfield deal. This marks the end of a lengthy legal battle, allowing Shell to focus on its core business activities.
